title.zh: 【Echo Protocol 将逐步关停协议，借贷、LSD 等业务已停止接受新存款】
title.en: 【Echo Protocol 将逐步关停协议，借贷、LSD 等业务已停止接受新存款】

current_state.zh: Echo Protocol is gradually shutting down after its May 2026 eBTC exploit, stopping new lending, Strategy, and LSD deposits while giving users until November 20 to withdraw, repay, and unstake before remaining positions are liquidated or settled.
current_state.en: Echo Protocol is gradually shutting down after its May 2026 eBTC exploit, stopping new lending, Strategy, and LSD deposits while giving users until November 20 to withdraw, repay, and unstake before remaining positions are liquidated or settled.
